newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean shares seen erratic, driven by results.
newsitem.headline: Chilean shares seen erratic, driven by results.

text.p: Chilean stocks are expected to be volatile at the opening, with the market moved by company first quarter earnings which must be released Wednesday, said traders.
"We'll see selective increases and decreases as the bolsa trades off earnings reports," said David Hurd, head of research at Merrill Lynch.
Eagerly awaited results include those of power utility Chilgener CHRN, which are expected to be good, said Hurd.
Chilgener, Chile's second largest generator, will release its earnings at a news conference at 1200 local (1700 GMT).
The 40-share .IPSA index closed Tuesday up 1.11 percent at 118.34 points.
